note: Facility projects described in S&P 100 annual reports. 'claim' is our one-line summary; the filing's own words are pulled by scripts/sites-filings.mjs into sites/results/filings.json and should be read before quoting. Coordinates were placed by eye on Sentinel-2 images (see sites/README.md) and mark the center of the construction area. claim_year is the year the filing gives for the start of physical work.

claims.claim: Construction of Gigafactory Texas began in 2020; Model Y production started there in 2022.

claims.site: Ohio One fabs, Licking County OH
claims.claim: Construction of two leading-edge fabs in Ohio began in 2022; later filings push completion to about 2030-2031.
Construction of new 300-mm wafer fabs in Sherman began in 2022; the first started production in 2025.
Ford is building BlueOval City, a vehicle and battery manufacturing campus in Tennessee; site work began in 2022.

claims.site: Ultium Cells battery plant, Lordstown OH
claims.claim: GM's Ultium Cells joint venture built a battery cell plant in Lordstown, Ohio, starting in 2020; it began production in 2022.

claims.site: Lebanon manufacturing site, Boone County IN
claims.claim: Lilly is building manufacturing sites in Lebanon, Indiana; construction began in 2023.

claims.site: Golden Pass LNG export terminal, Sabine Pass TX
claims.claim: ExxonMobil's Golden Pass LNG joint venture took its final investment decision in 2019 and is building liquefaction trains at the existing import terminal.

claims.site: Plant Vogtle Units 3 and 4, Waynesboro GA
claims.claim: Vogtle Units 3 and 4 entered commercial operation in 2023 and 2024. Construction started around 2013, before the Sentinel-2 archive, so this is a control for what 10 m imagery cannot see.
